_meta.status: DRAFT — not live. D7–D10 LOCKED Pedro 2026-09-30; other fields still for approval.
_meta.labels: REAL = named source · HIPOTESE = our method/rationale · PEDIR = Pedro supplies
_meta.npv_definition: NPV of the investor's own money (equity view, Gate 5 §2.3 FCF = Rev − Opex − debt service), nominal 8 %/yr, monthly, pre-tax, from the month the lot is won. IRR = equity IRR. With these flows NPV ≥ 0 at 8 % ⇔ IRR ≥ 8 % (one sign change; checked for every lot/bid).
_meta.win_rule_console: unchanged: win iff bid <= npcFloor + 1 (index.html wouldWinAuction). New npcFloor below = npc_best_bid − 1.
_meta.ui_formula_linear: npv_MEUR ≈ slope × (bid − breakeven) inside the good band; outside it use the npv_by_bid table (debt size depends on the bid, so NPV is not exactly linear).
_meta.never: NPV, never VAN. No historical print invented.

plant_life_after_cod_years.label: HIPOTESE (REAL anchor)
plant_life_after_cod_years.source: LBNL Wiser/Bolinger/Seel 2020: expected useful life 32,5 yrs (2019 survey); LBNL Utility-Scale Solar 2025: 35 yrs for plants built 2021+. US data, used as proxy

merchant_tail_capture_2026_eur_mwh.label: HIPOTESE
merchant_tail_capture_2026_eur_mwh.why: CR 0,68 × spot 66,18 (REAL OMIE 2025). 0,68 = PT/ES 2024 level (Gate 3 §2.2); 2025 was 0,54 (Synertics). We assume the trough partly recovers by 2045+ with 6,9 GW storage planned for 2030 (REAL strategy in consultation, pv magazine 23-09-2026). Sensitivity with 36 (CR 0,54) is in every lot

nominal_escalation.label: HIPOTESE
nominal_escalation.why: the 8 % is nominal, so merchant price and opex must be nominal too (ECB 2 % target). Gate 5 M-NPV kept 36 flat for 30 years = mixing real prices with a nominal rate

plant_eur_kwp_ex_hv.label: HIPOTESE (REAL anchors)
plant_eur_kwp_ex_hv.why: low-middle of Gate 4 540–780. Anchors: Akuo Santas 180 MW, 130 M€ all-in at financial close 2023 = 722 €/kWp incl. HV and financing (REAL, GreenUnivers 10-07-2023); IRENA 2024 global utility PV 691 USD/kWac (REAL); Solar Data Atlas PT utility 580–720 €/kWp (SECUNDÁRIO). PEDIR P4 (EPC print)

timeline.label: HIPOTESE / REAL build

caucao.label: REAL rule
caucao.source: DL 15/2022 art. 13; returned when plant runs

value.sizing: debt = min(80 % Capex, what 15-yr tariff cash can pay at DSCR 1,25)

project_finance.label: HIPOTESE / PEDIR P9
project_finance.why: Gate 5 §2.3 defines FCF in equity view (after debt service); gearing lock 60–80 %. kd 5 % = Euribor ~2 % + ~2,5–3 % margin/fees (HIPOTESE). Debt sized on the contract only: at low bids the bank lends less (REAL story: Akuo 14,76 needed 4 years and >20 % equity to close, GreenUnivers 2023)

tax.label: HIPOTESE / PEDIR
tax.why: same as Gate 5 M-NPV; IRC + derrama would lower NPV

discount_rate.why: 8 % = what the investor wants on its own money, after the bank (equity view)
